profile.name: Aditya Bidappa M V
profile.summary: I build and study security systems end to end — from zero-trust maturity frameworks and prompt-injection detection to IoMT threat modelling, deepfake analysis, and deployed apps. Research depth paired with shipping real tools.

aboutParagraphs: I'm a third-year Cybersecurity undergrad who treats research and engineering as the same discipline. My work moves between reading standards (NIST SP 800-207, CISA ZTMM v2) and turning them into things that run — CLI tools, deployed web apps, mobile auditors.

The through-line is measurable trust: scoring how exposed a network is, grading an organisation's zero-trust maturity, quantifying how likely a prompt is to be an injection. I care about correctness over shine, and about being honest when a metric is too good to be true.

profileNote.quote: I treat research and engineering as one discipline: read the standard, then make it run.
profileNote.note: Off the standards track, I'm chasing a chess line, a race start, or the next agent I'm wiring together — and reading more papers than I probably should.

projects.name: PromptGuard
projects.tagline: Prompt-injection risk scorer for LLM apps
highlights: FastAPI risk-scoring service with a React + TypeScript frontend and an XGBoost / scikit-learn backend.
Trained on Hugging Face prompt-injection data plus synthetic adversarial prompts generated locally with DeepSeek-R1 1.5B on Ollama.

projects.name: SME-ZT CLI
projects.tagline: Zero-trust maturity assessment for small & medium enterprises
highlights: A five-pillar, five-level maturity model aligned to CISA ZTMM v2, NIST SP 800-207 and CSA SMB guidance.
Weighted scoring with Level-1 capping logic to stop over-scoring, plus detailed textual self-assessment reports.
Validated against three documented SME breach case studies and folded into the published manuscript.

projects.name: MUN Argument Builder
projects.tagline: Deployed argument engine for Model UN delegates
highlights: Generates structured arguments, counter-arguments, evidence prompts and fallacy checks on demand.
FastAPI backend on Groq's Llama 3.1 70B, with GitHub-triggered auto-deploy on Render.
Custom domain via GoDaddy and TLS via Let's Encrypt.

projects.name: NetworkAudit
projects.tagline: Real-time Wi-Fi & hotspot security auditor for Android
highlights: Scans the connected network live and computes a 0–100 security score with an A–F grade.
Flags CVE-based findings: default gateway IPs, single DNS server, external-DNS logging risk and SSID identity leakage.
Full-stack: RN + Expo client, Express + Zod API, Neon PostgreSQL, EAS Build on Render.

projects.name: NutriLog
highlights: Owned the frontend, documentation and application logic for a PostgreSQL nutrition tracker.
Correctness-oriented design grounded in a BCNF-normalised schema.

Conducted authorized pentest on arovafitness.com and REST API (api.arovafitness.com) using Kali Linux and Burp Suite Community Edition — DNS/WHOIS recon, TLS review, HTTP header analysis, gobuster directory enumeration, and JavaScript bundle reverse-engineering to uncover an Express.js backend behind Cloudflare and map CORS preflight exposure on authentication-gated endpoints.

Parsed OpenAPI specification to catalog 86+ production endpoints across External API, Gym Panel API, and Fitness API services (73 JWT-authenticated, 18 unauthenticated, 22 AI-backed); produced a 352-route API surface map and structured findings reports covering open ports, service versions, and endpoint-level vulnerabilities.

Completed two assessment phases yielding 16 total findings (5 Phase 1 unauthenticated, 11 Phase 2 authenticated), including two Critical-severity vulnerabilities — premium plan escalation via PUT /api/user/plan and OTP invalidation flaws — validated via IDOR-style token-swapping and Hoppscotch functional test cases.

Architected 192-row exercise library (100 Warmup + 92 Cardio, 12-column schema); built Python/openpyxl data pipeline and Google Apps Script automation to bulk-rename and organize image assets in Drive with lowercase-underscore-numbered convention, validating the platform's live admin category system.

research.title: Zero Trust Maturity Assessment Framework for Small and Medium Enterprises (SME-ZT)
research.note: A five-pillar, five-level maturity framework with SME-specific weighting and Level-1 capping to prevent over-scoring, validated across three breach case studies.

research.title: Security Threats and Countermeasures in IoMT ML-driven Healthcare Systems
research.note: Survey of ML-based IoMT intrusion detection, federated learning, privacy preservation and layered defences against malware, DoS and adversarial attacks.

research.title: Deepfake Media Analysis: A Survey on Detection Techniques and Open Issues
research.note: Review of deepfake generation methods, benchmark datasets, detection techniques and the surrounding ethical and legal frameworks.

research.title: A Baseline Simulation Framework for DDoS Attack Detection in IoMT Networks
research.note: Wrote and formatted the full manuscript; showed that 'perfect' metrics on synthetic data arise from trivial one-dimensional separability in the SYN ratio.

roleProfiles.title: Back End Developer

roleProfiles.title: Full Stack Developer
roleProfiles.summary: Full-stack developer: React / React Native front ends, FastAPI and Express back ends, PostgreSQL data layers, and GitHub-triggered deploys with custom domains and TLS. Several projects are live in production.

roleProfiles.title: Security Engineer

roleProfiles.title: Penetration Tester

roleProfiles.title: Security Researcher
roleProfiles.summary: Security researcher and co-author of four papers spanning zero-trust maturity, IoMT threat modelling, deepfake detection and DDoS simulation. I write in LaTeX, validate against real breach case studies, and turn frameworks into runnable tools.

roleProfiles.title: Machine Learning Engineer
roleProfiles.summary: ML engineer focused on defensive security: an XGBoost prompt-injection classifier (87% accuracy, 95% precision) trained on Hugging Face data plus locally generated adversarial prompts, and published work on ML-driven intrusion detection and why 'perfect' metrics on synthetic data are a warning sign.

roleProfiles.title: Data Engineer

roleProfiles.title: Mobile Developer
